name: ops-team
description: Keeps a website running well after every deploy -- auditing SEO, copy, and broken links; producing on-brand design assets and web specs; and managing the build pipeline, DNS, and CI. 3 roles: Jenny (Design Lead), Jason (QA Reviewer), Eric (Infra Lead). Bring your own site standards, brand guidelines, and infra config.

interface.shortDescription: 3-role site ops team: QA audits, design assets, and infra/deploy pipeline
interface.longDescription: An AI Team of three specialized Digital Employees: Jenny leads design (thumbnails, social graphics, web specs), Jason audits sites post-deploy (SEO, copy, broken links), and Eric manages the build pipeline, DNS, and CI. Bring your own site standards, brand guidelines, and infra config.
defaultPrompt: Audit the site after this deploy -- SEO, copy, and broken links
Design a social graphic for this launch
Set up the CI pipeline for this new site
